criteria.matches_direction: The complete assembly retains the mockup's low brick vat, thin oak rim, two narrow rear posts, open center and broad top crossbar. The footprint is visibly lower and less monolithic than the previous structure.
criteria.geometry_uvs: All structure pieces use the existing full-block, slab, quarter-beam and eighth-cell geometry. The custom controller face exports as an opaque 32x32, 20-color texture with broad readable brick, iron, copper and leather regions.
criteria.material_consistency: Faithful brick and oak remain authoritative on construction blocks; the controller preserves the same warm masonry and dark functional metal balance.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: The controller remains front-center, the vat center is empty, rack parts are grounded and every required part can be placed with the existing saw-cut system and guide.
criteria.animation_states: The structure is static; existing controller active/fire state and ambient light behavior are unchanged.
criteria.native_size_readability: The 32x controller review keeps three iron slots, the copper drain and tan craft strip legible without fine noise.
